# Course Project v0.1.0-pre-teacher.2

This prerelease refreshes the pre-teacher-data delivery after the original `v0.1.0-pre-teacher` freeze. It includes the public-data completion work, the Chinese Evidence Workbench, live OpenAI-compatible model-session settings, reusable `.dat` fixtures, and the production PCAP/PCAPNG preprocessing path.

## Highlights

- Content-based PCAP/PCAPNG detection even when a capture is supplied with a `.dat` extension.
- Packaged transport-payload extraction with `dpkt==1.9.8`, with Scapy remaining optional.
- Structural DTLS recognition and fail-closed gating of generic unknown-protocol field inference.
- EvidenceGraph-PRE verification/fusion flow and local review export remain evidence-linked and abstention-capable.
- Windows Tauri 2 + React desktop app with a bundled Python Sidecar and optional session-only OpenAI-compatible LLM configuration.
- Public Modbus/TCP protocol/behavior benchmark evidence and reusable deterministic fixtures.

## Windows artifact

The release workflow builds an NSIS installer from this exact release commit, runs the packaged Sidecar PCAP/DTLS smoke as part of `npm run bundle:windows`, and uploads both the installer and its SHA-256 checksum to the GitHub Release.

## Scientific and security boundary

This is still a pre-teacher-data release. It does not claim teacher-data packet/field F1, semantic accuracy, restoration accuracy, or plaintext-recovery performance. Correctly implemented modern encryption is not claimed to be broken without keys or other legitimate recovery material. Public/synthetic fixtures are development, regression, and mechanism evidence only.

## Upgrade note

Developers building the Sidecar locally should use `npm run sidecar:smoke` or `npm run bundle:windows`. The packaging bootstrap now checks both the pinned PyInstaller version and the packaged PCAP runtime dependency before freezing the executable.
